answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity with a staked bond tied to verifiable work. An agent locks a deposit and answers sampled benchmark tasks each epoch; a quorum slashes the bond of any identity that stalls or fakes output. To forge a thousand workers, a sybil must lock a thousand deposits and run a thousand instances, as a resultless identity loses its stake. Each fake costs a full bond plus compute, linear in the attack. Real traffic grounds this: a node at a wharf attests only to agents streaming sensor frames, and a sparrow that merely echoes an alarm earns nothing.
